verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented first-party feature for exporting all Auth data, such as users, identities or MFA factors, in open formats for migration away. The closest item is the ability to connect Auth data to your own tables via triggers and foreign keys, which is a developer building block rather than an export or exit capability. A community comment that copying user data is 'trivial' describes a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can connect this data to your own tables using triggers and foreign key references.
